title: Review of c01 fch-uptake-cargo (SIWD): replicated on seed 7 with a chi=0 twin; Supported, with W holding by construction (equilibrium partitioning, no wall)
summary: Re-ran the world unchanged on seed 7 and a chi=0 copy (world_chi0.py, only chi changed) on the same seed. Micelles form from noise by t=16 (37 bodies), grow on the feed and divide in waves: 25 splits, 17 persistent, max generation 3, 0 merges (rerun/seed7/lineage.png). Solute contrast rises from 18x (t=40) to 165x (t=400), with 92-100% of bodies >= 2x per frame (cargo_contrast_seed7.txt); with chi=0 every frame is 1.0x and the bodies and splits are identical (the solute is passive). The contrast tracks the partition factor exp(|chi| du) of each body (peak c ratio 2-1100x against exp(3 du) 11-5200x on five bodies at t=400), so the 'containment' is equilibrium solubility in the micelle core that any droplet with this coupling would show: I mark W as holding by construction, as the author's limits already say (no wall, re-equilibration rather than inheritance).

observations.I: rerun/seed7/FACTS.md: 35 persistent tracks, area ratio 2.56, discrete micelles
observations.W: cargo_contrast_seed7.txt: 165x aggregate at t=400, 98-100% of bodies >= 2x from t=240; cargo_contrast_chi0_seed7.txt: 1.0x every frame
observations.D: rerun/seed7/lineage.png: 17 persistent splits, generation 3, 0 merges, from noise-formed founders

controls_run.W: rerun_chi0/seed7 (chi=0, same seed): 1.0x in every frame, identical bodies and splits

verdicts.limitation: W is the Boltzmann partition of a passive solute into amphiphile-rich cores (contrast scales with exp(|chi| du)); there is no boundary layer and daughters refill by re-equilibration, so it would hold for any droplet with this coupling; the lowered-D twin fails trivially because a uniform source with linear diffusion cannot make contrast. Divisions come in feed-driven waves and many gen-0 founders never divide. Not checked: dt/2.
